args.title: Late-Deploy Coverage Note
args.body:
# Late-Deploy Coverage Note

The Q3 2022 weekend incident should have taught us that deployment timing is part of incident risk. Its small blast radius and lucky timing made it feel like random bad luck, so we moved on without documenting the lesson or defining coverage expectations.

Before the March outage, we should have established a clear rule: no late or Friday deploys without confirmed team coverage and a straightforward rollback path. The March incident showed the cost of leaving that implicit—when problems began after people went offline, a small root cause became an 18-hour response. Any unavoidable late deploy requires the whole team on standby; otherwise, it waits.
